interpretation: Heat-FE OLS shows a significant positive association (+0.279, p=0.009) for sponsor-aligned surfers within heats; the within-surfer paired test is null (+0.10, p=0.48, n=30 surfers with both event types), indicating the heat-FE association reflects which surfers hold brand deals rather than an event-sponsor scoring lift. Per-event variation is large (-0.6 to +0.5).
